## Presentation - OT Compact Communications

Amanda Perry, ED of OT Compact, presents on public relations efforts.

- OT Compact has been active since Fall 2022
- Annual Reports
- o High level committee information, graphics and visuals
- o Sustainability report
- Newsletter
- o Quarterly, internal information
- Website
- o Meetings updates such as minutes and documents
- Compact Connect
- o Data system in progress
- Presentation template
- o OT Compact presentation for interested parties

## Review and Adopt Agenda

- Clarification that quorum has been established.
- o C. Lumen is a voting member. Oklahoma PA Compact came into effect Nov 2024.
- Committee reviewed the agenda; Chair Fischer called for a motion to adopt the agenda.
- Committee is not slated to vote on anything today.
- Motion :
- o C. Lumen motioned that the committee adopt the agenda.
- o R. MacArthur seconded the motion.
- o All in favor, Motion carried.

## Review Minutes

Committee reviews minutes from October 30, 2024. Quorum was not established.

- Committee discusses ratifying Oct 30 meeting. Decides against it because no voting members from the Oct 30 meeting were present.
- Other than agenda, there were no items voted on at the Oct 30 meeting. Oct 30 is instead classified for informational purposes only.

## Schedule Future Meetings

Frequency of meetings discussed

- Every other month should be enough.
- Packet for states considering the PA Compact is a priority - committee agrees to a February meeting to discuss this item.
- J. Thomas will send out meeting availability poll for last week of February.
